evaluation_status: exploratory: all preserved 2026 waves exposed; no untouched evaluation sample established
selection: none; fixed candidates and no parameter tuning
asof_training: targets <= min(anchor,2025); core MLBAM mod5 1,2,3; probability calibration ID4; exposed ID0 and prior 2026 waves for descriptive evaluation only
availability_definition: true full availability means eligible for the role on every scheduled regular-season date, no medical or roster absence; not identifiable from preserved annual data
role_retention_definition: same usage role throughout scheduled season; annual aggregate same-role labels are only a proxy and cannot certify daily retention
role_inference: forecast inputs only; most recent positive verified season in three years; H PA/GP >=3.8 everyday, >=2.8 platoon, otherwise bench; GP missing PA>=400 everyday-proxy otherwise uncertain; P GS/GP>=0.8 starter, <=0.1 reliever, otherwise swingman
scenario_slots_note: available all season does not mean plays162 games; generic role scheduling scenarios, not arbitrary lower bounds on expectations
proxy_warning: high-usage role-retention proxy, not verified full health. Fitted proxy is NOT described as a medical full-availability forecast. Unknown GP never meets proxy. Pandemic2020 excluded from proxy training/evaluation.
expected_equation: joint outcomes absent, retained_high_usage, retained_reduced, changed, unknown_role; W = sum_s P(s|asof) * scenario_capacity * E(target_work/scenario_capacity | s,asof). Absence appears once. Learned count ratios include joint missed-time and opportunity loss; medical causation not identifiable.
full_role_fit: squared-error appearance regressions only on future same-role/high-usage proxy eligible targets, min60 core rows per role; else transparent scenario. Predictor never includes target labels. Work per appearance frozen asof demonstrated depths.
joint_fit: fixed HistGradientBoosting settings inherited; calibrate joint classifier logistic ID4 when >=100 rows and >=10 per class; role-specific ridge ratio regressions alpha250, min60 rows, else empirical shrinkage to family/state mean; no blending statistical targets
allocator: current verified membership and2026 team budgets reused separately; no historical current-roster backfill; sensitivity only, no accuracy claim without dated historical rosters
medical: reuse dated preserved evidence, numeric envelope scenario separately; never infer medical absence from lower usage; cannot prove incremental independence of envelope versus learned interruption risk
